Chapter 6149: Immortal Suppressor’S Arrival

Chapter 6149: Immortal Suppressor’s Arrival

“Boom!” Today, a blinding radiance from Immortal Suppression Dynasty emanated across Sin.

“What’s going on?!” The weak and strong became alarmed.

“Ooo-” A domineering command horn could be heard in all corners and paralyzed listeners with fear.

“The horns of Immortal Suppression!” Emperors and desolate gods became afraid.

“When was the last time?” An emperor asked while staring in the dynasty’s direction.

“Long, long ago, it was to march against Enigma Dynasty.” His friend had a serious expression.

“What is the purpose this time? Could it be Enigma again?” A desolate god took a deep breath.

“War is coming.” This became the thing on everyone’s mind.

“I thought Tranquility Emperor mentioned no war.” An ancestor said.

“Yes, he has always advocated for peace.” Someone responded.

Everyone trusted Tranquility Emperor and his reign over Immortal Suppression proved his pacifistic nature. Battles rarely occurred, let alone an all-out match.

However, the light and the horn made them imagine the worst-case scenario. A sentimental sigh reached all of them. The more powerful cultivators saw someone leaving Immortal Suppression with a sword tied to his back.

“Tranquility Emperor!” An emperor became emotional.

“Tranquility Emperor is leaving Immortal Suppression Dynasty!” This news traveled like a storm across Sin.

“How can this be?” Many couldn’t believe it.

“He’s the first and most respected emperor, why is he leaving?” A big shot said.

Not only was he in an authoritative position, his prestige was well-earned. Members of the dynasty respected him and obeyed his orders. That’s the reason why the other emperors listened and stopped fighting several times.

Anyone could leave the dynasty but not him. He had reigned for many years and helped groom numerous emperors and desolate gods, contributing greatly to the dynasty’s prosperity.

Nevertheless, emperors saw him leaving without turning back. No one knew of his destination.

“With him gone, the pro-war faction will take the lead. They’ll be as ferocious as a tiger let out of the cage, a war with Enigma is inevitable.” Someone predicted the future.

“I’m sure that is what going on right now, a march towards Enigma.” A big shot whispered.

Sects and kingdoms worried. Some planned on how to deal with the worst-case scenario, preparing to seal themselves off or evacuate.

Enigma could be the first to fall and then they would be next. It was either submission or destruction before the cavalries.

“His heart was willing but he couldn’t control everything.” A desolate god sighed.

“Yes, Immortal Suppressor is still above him.” Everyone understood why the horn of war was raging.

Tranquility Emperor wasn’t stronger than the only primal ancestor in Sin - the dynasty’s true master. He had been reclusive for a long time but this didn’t mean he was replaced. The moment he showed up, he would regain all of his authority.

“Immortal Suppressor is showing up soon.” An emperor speculated with a serious expression.

This possibility made everyone shudder.

“Immortal Suppression Dynasty might try to unite Sin once more.” Another said.

“Rumble!” Loud explosions came from Immortal Suppression.

A figure with three eyes emerged, heading for Enigma Dynasty. When he opened his third eye, it formed a vortex sucking everything inside.

“Yin-eye Emperor.” Many recognized this eleven-fruit emperor.
